description.text: Based on cybernetics, information theory and system theory, control science studies common problems independent of specific objects in various fields, that is, how to describe and analyze objects and environmental information, and what kind of control and decision-making behavior to take in order to achieve certain goals. It has a general methodological significance for each specific application field, and the combination with the specific problems in each field forms a rich and diverse content of control engineering. This feature of this discipline makes it play a strong role in promoting the development of related disciplines, and shows outstanding vitality in the interdisciplinary and penetrating. For example, its integration with information science and computer science has opened up the fields of knowledge engineering and intelligent robotics. The combination of sociology and economics makes the research object enter the category of social system and economic system. The combination with biology and medicine has promoted the development of biological cybernetics more effectively. At the same time, the development of adjacent disciplines such as computer, communication, microelectronics and cognitive science has also promoted the new development of control science and engineering, so that the research field involved in this discipline has been expanded.

duration.text: The Control Theory and Engineering at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Valid passport copies.2.passport and two inch photo (photo of passport) ;3.application form ;4.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)5.physical examination form;6.non-criminal record;7.Proof of bank deposit.8. Highest diploma, including senior high school diploma or bachelor’s degree certificate needed in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.9. Academic transcripts: Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.10.Stamped Transcript from the undergraduate/master program or notarized Chinese/English-translated transcript.11. A study or research plan. Applicants for postgraduate degrees are required to submit a study or research plan in Chinese or in English.12.Recommendation letters: Applicants for postgraduate studies must submit two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors.13.Valid HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs, or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for the Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 30.Applicants for the Master's degree in Civil Engineering must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
